threads.summary: A Capture Tech cannot see the 'I would like to accept this job' / 'decline this job' options on the job request form for JOBID6622735036817477854 (Somerled Designs, 423 47 Street NW, Bradenton FL), and hits the same blank selection when he clicks Schedule in Airtable.
threads.note: Both phase records (93496 / 93497) are already at Job Status = Scheduled, and the accept/decline URL passes live status in as jobStatusAT, so the accept + date/time block no longer renders. threads.author: Stephenie Yong
threads.summary: Livit Jotform confirmation emails render dates as mm/dd/yy instead of the international dd/mm/yy format, and 'preferred scan time' is not a required field on the Livit Jotform, so confirmations show 12am when the agent submits a date only.
threads.note: Both issues logged against COP-2019 with JOBID6613077533619588764 as the example. Stephenie has acknowledged and is manually amending confirmed jobs meanwhile. Blocked on our decision: patch the legacy Livit form now, or fold the fix into the form migration. Next action is ours.
